title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
description: Two brothers use alchemy in search of the Philosopher's Stone to restore their bodies after a failed ritual.
facts: It adapts Hiromu Arakawa's manga, which ran in Monthly Shonen Gangan from 2001 to 2010.
Studio Bones produced the series, which has 64 episodes.
Unlike the 2003 anime, Brotherhood follows the manga's story from the start through to the ending.
Arakawa grew up on a dairy farm in Hokkaido, which she has said shaped the farm life seen in the story.
The series is built around the alchemy principle of 'equivalent exchange'.
It aired from April 2009 to July 2010.
Yasuhiro Irie directed the series.
Akira Senju composed the music.
Its first opening theme was 'Again' by Yui.
The Elric brothers' attempt at human transmutation sets the entire plot in motion.

title: Attack on Titan
description: Humanity lives behind enormous walls to hide from giant man-eating Titans, until the walls are breached.
facts: It adapts Hajime Isayama's manga, which began in Bessatsu Shonen Magazine in 2009.
Wit Studio animated the early seasons, and MAPPA took over for The Final Season.
Isayama has said an unpleasant encounter with a customer at his internet cafe job helped inspire the Titans.
The Japanese title is 'Shingeki no Kyojin'.
Hiroyuki Sawano composed the music, and 'Guren no Yumiya' by Linked Horizon opened season one.
The manga ended in April 2021 after 139 chapters.
The anime concluded with The Final Chapters special in November 2023.
The three walls protecting humanity are named Maria, Rose and Sina.
The manga has sold well over 100 million copies worldwide.
The anime premiered on April 7, 2013.
